note: Every material claim in the release drafts. EVIDENCED claims name the layer they were earned at and the evidence files; REAL_WORLD claims stay NOT_RUN until external evidence exists (scripts/release/journey-gate.mjs). Checked by scripts/release/claim-check.mjs against docs/coverage/coverage.json.

claims.text: Authenticated telemetry is accepted, duplicates and out-of-order samples are handled, and stale or offline sensors are shown as such (local integrated tests).
A threshold breach opens one incident even under concurrent triggers (local integrated tests).
Evidence facts carry citations to an exact document revision and injected document instructions are isolated (local tests with synthetic documents and a contract-fake reasoning adapter).
Compatibility is decided deterministically: exact parts ALLOW, ambiguous matches HOLD, substitutes need a named engineer (local tests).
Spending is bounded by an approved, signed execution authority with hard budget and purpose limits (local tests against a recorded-contract broker).
Only the broker process holds the paid credential and paid egress; other code cannot import it (local code and process tests; deployed network isolation is NOT_RUN).
An ambiguous payment outcome stays UNKNOWN and is reconciled before any retry (local tests against a recorded-contract broker).
Provider completion alone cannot close an incident; closure needs the stable sensor window and authoritative sign-off (local integrated tests).
The operator console shows stale, unknown and unsupported states honestly and is keyboard and screen-reader operable (local browser tests).
Every runner is scheduled in the worker with per-runner locks, failure isolation and graceful shutdown (local tests).
A clean clone builds, migrates, starts and passes health, readiness and authenticated smoke checks in a local compose stack (local layer only; a hosted deployment is NOT_RUN).
Backup, restore and image rollback were exercised locally against the compose database (local layer only).
Each external action has its own release gate and none is authorized; every gate is REFUSED (local tests and repository state).
The real-input journey gate refuses simulated, replayed, fixture and recorded-contract evidence (local tests).
A real authenticated physical sensor opening an incident: NOT_RUN (no device, no authorization).

A real SERV Reasoning (OpenServ) run returning a validated cited proposal on a real document, as part of a complete real-input journey: NOT_RUN (the claim maps to T-058, which stays NOT_RUN until one journey passes every part). Recorded so far: journey j-2026-11-12-serv-document-2 (source commit 28d05f0) ingested the published Dixell XR60CX manual with parser v3 and made one real serv-mini run; the product's citation validation accepted its proposal (COMPLETED, a MODEL PROPOSAL with no authority, 7 citations re-opened and verified, $0.024365), so the journey gate reads document PASS and reasoning PASS. The earlier journey j-2026-11-12-serv-document (ca59099) made one run whose proposal the product REJECTED (CITATION_OUT_OF_RANGE, CITATION_QUOTE_MISMATCH). Sensor, payment, fulfillment, recovery, duplicate and timeout parts are NOT_RUN. Local tests still use a contract-fake adapter.

A real bounded Kite-paid action with downstream fulfillment, as part of a complete real-input journey: NOT_RUN (the claim maps to T-058, which stays NOT_RUN until one journey passes every part). Recorded so far: journey j-2026-11-13-kite-payment-2 (run at 60bc5c5, owner-signed PAYMENT authorization auth-payment-20261113-86104d) made one paid call of USD 0.01 through the broker to lionx402.com, whose OpenStreetMap search answered HTTP 200 with 7 results; the broker recorded the outcome UNKNOWN because kpass reported a settlement chain id (2366) other than the merchant's Base (8453), and the owner as finance approver resolved it CAPTURED from read-only Kite and wallet evidence (recorded at 758a1ae). The journey gate reads payment PASS, fulfillment PASS and duplicate PASS (the duplicate request returned the same intent with no second payment). The chain id 2366 is an open question. The first attempt (j-2026-11-13-kite-payment) made no payment. Sensor, recovery and timeout parts are NOT_RUN. Local tests still use the RECORDED_CONTRACT adapter.
Independent physical recovery evidence (sensor window plus CMMS or authorized technician): NOT_RUN.
A hosted deployment reachable from a clean client: NOT_RUN (no DEPLOY authorization).
Public repository, uploaded video, X post and hackathon submission: NOT_RUN (each needs its own explicit authorization).
Production load, availability SLOs, edge/WAF protection and enforced network policy: NOT_RUN (local measurements and reference configuration only).
